      "line": 2227,
      "message": "`_runner_run_id` read from the new latest-symlink auto-resume state file is not sanitized, while the fresh-run path explicitly strips unsafe characters to prevent path traversal via `ZBUILD_RUN_ID` in filenames; two plugins use `ZBUILD_RUN_ID` directly in path constructions.",
      "quote": "_runner_run_id=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" '.run_id' \"$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$\")\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "path traversal",
      "severity": "medium",
      "line": 2223,
      "message": "The path returned by `readlink -f \"$state_dir/latest\"` is assigned as `state_dir` with no check that it remains within the expected state root; an adversary who controls the `latest` symlink redirects all artifact operations, `ZBUILD_STATE_DIR` exports, and `mkdir` calls to an arbitrary filesystem location.",
      "quote": "state_dir=\"$_lr_resolved_dir\"\n                    state_file=\"$state_dir/pipeline-state.json\"\n                    _runner_state_file=\"$state_file\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/state/artifact-persist.sh",
      "category": "path traversal",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 644,
      "message": "`_artifact_persist_put_back` guards only against an absolute `rel` (the prefix-strip failure case) but not against `..` components; a hostile git state branch that places a file at a path whose stripped relative form begins with `../` could write outside the artifact directory, and the new resume rehydration call site adds a second consumer of this gap.",
      "quote": "# Guard: skip if strip failed (trailing slash on $from) — rel would be absolute\n        [[ \"$rel\" == /* ]] && continue",
      "introduced": false,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
